sloka: कपि सिम्हा प्रकर्षन्तु शतशो अथ सहस्रशः ।गजः च गिरि सम्काशो गवयः च महाबलः ॥६-४-१५॥।।
transliteration: kapi simhā prakarṣantu śataśo atha sahasraśaḥ ।gajaḥ ca giri samkāśo gavayaḥ ca mahābalaḥ ॥6-4-15॥।।

translations.english: "Gaja who is like a mountain in form, Gavaya, the mighty strong and Gavaksha would go like proud bulls that lead the cows".
